I have worked as a patient care technician at Example Community Hospital since 2025. On a med-surg unit I take vitals, assist with patient mobility, and chart in the EHR, so I am comfortable with the basic skills that screening events depend on. My clinical rotations included community health as well as med-surg and pediatrics, and I hold a CNA certificate and BLS. I also built a falls-prevention poster for a unit quality project, which gave me practice turning a health topic into something patients and staff can use. Patient education is a skill I want to keep building.

I would welcome the chance to support your outreach and screening events and learn how a county health department serves its community. Thank you for your consideration.
